help.title: Help centre

faqItems.a: A platform that connects landowners who need investment with investors looking for agricultural projects in Azerbaijan.

faqItems.q: Is it free to list my land?
faqItems.a: Yes. Listing land and receiving requests is free during the pilot period.

faqItems.q: How is a winning investor chosen?
faqItems.a: Several investors can send requests. The landowner reviews them and selects one. The listing then closes and the other investors are informed.
Azerbaijani, English and Russian. Use the switcher at the top of every page.

investSteps: Create an account and open the Investor Cabinet.
Use Find Land to filter by budget, region and field type.
Compare up to two lands side by side.
Send an investment request and follow its status in My Investments.
listSteps: Create an account and open the Landowner Cabinet.
Click Add Land and complete the six short steps.
Upload photos and the ownership document.
After review your land is published and investors can send requests.
accountSteps: Forgot your password? Use “Forgot password?” on the login page.
Did not receive the email code? Check the spam folder and try again.
Still stuck? Contact us by phone or WhatsApp.
help.reportText: Tell us what went wrong and on which page. Screenshots help.

home.whatText: AGROInvest is a digital marketplace where farm owners list agricultural land that needs capital, and investors find, compare and fund the projects that suit them. Every listing is reviewed, and every step — from first request to final decision — is transparent.
home.videoText: A short walkthrough: how to sign up, log in and find your way around the site.
home.ownersTitle: Turn your land into a growing business
home.ownersText: List your fields, orchards or pastures for free, set your own investment terms and choose the investor you trust. Our team reviews every listing so serious investors can find you with confidence.
home.investorsTitle: Invest in land you can see and understand
home.investorsText: Search verified listings by budget, region and field type, see a suitability score for each one, compare two lands side by side and send your request in a few clicks.

about.title: About AGROInvest
about.intro: We believe Azerbaijan's land can feed more families and create more jobs when the right people work together. AGROInvest makes that partnership simple, safe and transparent.

facts.title: Founded
facts.text: AGROInvest was founded in 2025 in Baku by a small team of agronomists and software engineers.

facts.title: Our mission
facts.text: To bring capital and know-how to agricultural land that is ready to grow — especially in the regions being restored.

facts.title: What we do
facts.text: We list and review land, match it with investors, and keep every request and decision transparent.

facts.title: Who we serve
facts.text: Farm and land owners who need investment, and private or company investors who want real, local projects.

about.videoText: Watch how AGROInvest connects a family orchard in Zangilan with an investor from Baku — from the first visit to the first harvest.
